name: Tomari (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Tomari village emblem in navy: a broken ring enclosing a four-pointed star with a disc.
history: Municipal flag of Tomari, a village in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 25 February 1937.

features.role: Tomari village emblem — a broken ring enclosing a four-pointed star with a disc
